column2: We waited for the light to turn green and then crossed the street.
column3: 我們等燈變綠，然後過了馬路。
column5: cross 長得像十字路口的十字，兩條路交會，你就要走過去

column2: Mom strung colorful lights along the fence for the party.
column3: 媽媽為了派對在圍籬上掛起了彩色燈串。
column5: string 是細繩，動詞就是用繩子把東西串起來掛好

column2: I was so sleepy that I could hardly keep my eyes open.
column3: 我睏到幾乎睜不開眼睛。
column5: hardly 不是 hard 的副詞：hard 努力，hardly 幾乎沒有

column2: Grandpa sat in his old armchair and read the newspaper.
column3: 爺爺坐在他的舊扶手椅上看報紙。
column4: sit in an armchair (坐在扶手椅上)
column5: arm 手臂 + chair 椅子，有地方靠手臂的椅子

column2: We made all the arrangements for the school trip last week.
column3: 我們上週就把校外教學的一切都安排好了。
column5: arrange 排好，加 ment 變名詞，就是排好的計畫

column2: Our baby-sitter reads stories to the twins until they fall asleep.
column3: 保姆念故事給雙胞胎聽，直到他們睡著。
column5: baby 寶寶 + sit 坐著看顧 + er 人，坐在旁邊顧寶寶的人

column2: The banker explained how to open a savings account.
column3: 銀行家說明了如何開立儲蓄帳戶。
column5: bank 銀行 + er 人，在銀行裡管錢的人

column2: Before you play the piano, you should learn the basics.
column3: 彈鋼琴之前，你應該先學會基礎知識。
column5: basics 像蓋房子的 base 地基，一定要先打好

column2: Trust is the basis of every good friendship.
column3: 信任是每一段好友誼的基礎。
column4: the basis of friendship (友誼的基礎)
column5: basis 拼音像 base 加尾巴，都是底部、地基的意思

column2: We went bowling on Saturday and I knocked down seven pins.
column3: 我們週六去打保齡球，我打倒了七個瓶。
column5: bowl 是滾動的球，bowling 就是把球滾出去的運動

column2: The three little pigs built a strong house out of brick.
column3: 三隻小豬用磚頭蓋了一間堅固的房子。
column5: brick 諧音「不力客」，磚頭要硬才不會裂

column2: On Sunday we had brunch at ten, so we skipped lunch.
column3: 星期日我們十點吃了早午餐，所以沒吃午餐。
column5: br 來自 breakfast，unch 來自 lunch，兩餐合成一餐

column2: She carried a bundle of letters tied with a blue ribbon.
column3: 她拿著一捆用藍緞帶綁起來的信。
column5: bundle 諧音「半都」，一半都是一捆東西綁在一起

column2: Tom ordered a cheese burger and a small glass of milk.
column3: 湯姆點了一個起司漢堡和一小杯牛奶。
column5: burger 諧音「伯格」，伯格先生最愛吃的漢堡

column2: Students line up in the school cafeteria at noon.
column3: 學生們中午在學校餐廳排隊。
column5: cafe 咖啡店 + teria，自己端盤子拿餐點的地方

column2: My dad still keeps old songs on a cassette in the car.
column3: 我爸爸還把老歌錄在車裡的卡式錄音帶上。
column5: cassette 諧音「卡賽特」，卡進機器裡的帶子

column2: Do you want catsup on your French fries?
column3: 你的薯條要加番茄醬嗎？
column4: catsup and fries (番茄醬配薯條)
column5: catsup 裡有 cat 貓，貓愛吃紅紅的番茄醬

column2: A tiny cell is the basic building block of every living thing.
column3: 一個小小的細胞是所有生物的基本組成單位。
column5: cell 像一格一格的小房間，每個小房間就是一個細胞

column2: My little sister is learning to eat noodles with a chopstick.
column3: 我妹妹正在學用筷子吃麵。
column5: chop 是快速切夾，stick 是小棍子，兩根棍子夾菜

column2: The kids made little bowls out of soft clay in art class.
column3: 孩子們在美勞課用軟黏土捏出小碗。
column5: clay 諧音「可累」，捏黏土捏到手很累

column2: The clerk at the shop put my books in a paper bag.
column3: 店裡的店員把我的書放進紙袋裡。
column5: clerk 發音像「可樂客」，店員幫客人拿可樂

column2: A cock crows loudly at sunrise to wake up the farm.
column3: 公雞在日出時大聲啼叫，把農場叫醒。
column5: cock 諧音「咖」，公雞「咖咖」地叫

column2: The completion of the new bridge took almost two years.
column3: 新橋的完工花了將近兩年。
column4: the completion of a project (專案完成)
column5: complete 完成 + ion 變名詞，事情做到結束

column2: Confucius was a famous teacher in ancient China.
column3: 孔子是古代中國有名的老師。
column4: the teachings of Confucius (孔子的教誨)
column5: Confucius 諧音「康福修斯」，孔子讓人康福的教導

column2: Congratulations on winning first place in the speech contest!
column3: 恭喜你贏得演講比賽第一名！
column5: congratulation 諧音「恐懼拉」，別怕，高興地道賀吧

column2: The controller pressed a button to move the toy robot.
column3: 操縱者按下按鈕讓玩具機器人動起來。
column5: control 控制 + er，控制東西的人或裝置

column2: Our conversation on the bus was about weekend plans.
column3: 我們在公車上的對話是關於週末計畫。
column5: con 一起 + verse 轉 + ation，你一句我一句輪流轉

column2: Put the rice in the rice cooker and press the button.
column3: 把米放進電鍋，然後按下按鈕。
column5: cook 煮 + er 的東西，幫你煮飯的機器

column2: Our county has a big park where families meet on Sundays.
column3: 我們郡有一座大公園，家人們週日會在那裡聚會。
column5: county 諧音「康提」，一個比城鎮更大的行政區

column2: In Taiwan, it is a custom to eat dumplings at New Year.
column3: 在台灣，過年吃水餃是一種習俗。
column5: custom 諧音「卡斯談」，大家都照著做的老習慣

column2: The water was cold to a degree that made us stop swimming.
column3: 水冷到讓我們不得不停止游泳的程度。
column4: to some degree (在某種程度上)
column5: degree 像溫度計上的一格一格，用來量程度

column2: For dessert, we shared a piece of strawberry cake.
column3: 我們飯後一起分食了一塊草莓蛋糕當甜點。
column5: dessert 兩個 s 像兩勺糖，多一個 s 是甜甜的

column2: Drops of dew shone on the grass early in the morning.
column3: 清晨草地上的露珠閃閃發亮。
column5: dew 諧音「丟」，水珠一顆顆丟在草葉上

column2: The boy drew a green dinosaur with a very long tail.
column3: 男孩畫了一隻有著長長尾巴的綠色恐龍。
column5: dinosaur 諧音「呆樓梭」，巨大的恐龍笨重地爬樓梯

column2: Tom and Amy had a disagreement about where to eat lunch.
column3: 湯姆和艾咪對午餐要去哪裡吃意見不同。
column5: dis 不 + agreement 同意，兩個人不同意

column2: The farmer rode a donkey to the market with two baskets.
column3: 農夫騎著驢子帶著兩個籃子去市場。
column5: donkey 諧音「動奇」，驢子一動就很奇怪地叫

column2: I ate a doughnut with chocolate on top after school.
column3: 放學後我吃了一個上面有巧克力的甜甜圈。
column4: a chocolate doughnut (巧克力甜甜圈)
column5: dough 麵糰 + nut 堅果，圓圓的麵糰炸成小堅果的樣子

column2: Her drawing of a cat won a prize in the art show.
column3: 她畫的貓咪素描在藝術展中得了獎。
column5: draw 畫 + ing，畫出來的那張圖就是 drawing

column2: I bought cough medicine and a toothbrush at the drugstore.
column3: 我在藥局買了咳嗽藥和一支牙刷。
column5: drug 藥 + store 商店，賣藥也賣日用品的店

column2: Water is an important element in the food we cook.
column3: 水是我們所煮食物中的重要成分。
column5: element 像一格一格的元素表，每格是組成世界的小成分
